description: This file defines the interface for Cellular Manager's message bus functionality, including initialization, finalization, resource management, and bus checking functions. It contains macro definitions, function prototypes, and include directives, serving as an interface header for the CellularManager module within the project.

methods.name: CellularMgr_MessageBus_Init
methods.description: Initializes the message bus with provided component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: CellularMgr_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Performs internal initialization of the Cellular Manager message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: CellularMgr_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Performs cleanup and finalization of the Cellular Manager message bus interface.

methods.name: CellularMgr_Mbi_BusCheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus for the Cellular Manager.

methods.name: CellularMgr_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the Cellular Manager message bus interface, with specified priority.
